    注

（１）グループＦ２１Ｖ１／００からＦ２１Ｖ１４／００は、光の発散または分配に関する観点を包含する。グループＦ２１Ｖ１５／００からＦ２１Ｖ３１／００は、光の発散または分配に関しない観点を包含する。［２００９．０１］

F21V.en:
FUNCTIONAL FEATURES OR DETAILS OF LIGHTING DEVICES OR SYSTEMS THEREOF; STRUCTURAL COMBINATIONS OF LIGHTING DEVICES WITH OTHER ARTICLES, NOT OTHERWISE PROVIDED FOR;

Note(s)

  • Groups F21V1/00 to F21V14/00 cover aspects related to light emission or distribution. Groups F21V15/00 to F21V31/00 cover aspects not related to light emission or distribution.
  • Details of non-electric lighting devices or systems are classified in groups F21V35/00 to F21V37/00 only if a special adaptation related to the use of a non-electric light source is of interest.
  • In this subclass, it is desirable to add the indexing codes of subclasses F21W and F21Y.
